text: Tiago's dad passed away on Sunday after a long time in the hospice. Tiago sounded exhausted but calm, and said his sister has been doing most of the arrangements. The funeral is at St Mary's on 2 November 2026 at eleven, with a wake at the cricket club afterwards. Remind me to send flowers to his mum before then.
Spoke to Joanna on the phone. She was made redundant on Friday along with most of her team. She sounded flat but says she's fine. I should check in with her next week.
Need to renew my passport before March 2027. The form is in the drawer under the printer.

Kiri and Leon have split up after six years. She told me over lunch and was surprisingly matter-of-fact about it. She's staying in the flat for now and he's gone back to his parents' place in Leeds. They're still sharing their dog Juno, which she admits is a bit awkward.
Lunch with Duc on June 3rd. He suggested the Vietnamese place near his office.
Dentist moved to 5/14 at 9:15. Pick up the dry cleaning on the way back.
Blessing's grandmother died last week. She's flying out to Lagos on Thursday for the burial and will be gone about ten days. Don't forget to message her while she's away.
Gareth is a huge Wrexham fan and has a season ticket. He also mentioned he's been learning Welsh on Duolingo.
Call Rebecca back about the weekend. She wants to come and visit with the kids around May 14.
Caitlin's engagement is off. She didn't want to talk about it much, just said they'd agreed it wasn't right. Must remember not to ask about the venue.
Post the parcel to Yusuf by Friday so it reaches him before his birthday on 9 December 2026.

Kaito said his redundancy meeting is on Tuesday. He's really anxious about it because they've only just bought the house and his wife is on maternity leave until June 2027. He's been told about a third of the department will go. I'd like to message him on Tuesday evening to see how it went.
Santiago, or Santi as everyone calls him, is moving back to Valencia in January 2027. Leaving drinks are on the 12th.
Shreya's cat Pickle had to be put to sleep yesterday. She was in bits on the phone. Maybe drop round with some biscuits at the weekend.
I'm going to the funeral with Yaw on Monday. Leaving at eight.
Remind me to ask Ryan how the appeal went. He had the hearing on Wednesday.
Heather's husband left in August and she's only just started telling people. She's doing a pottery class on Tuesday evenings now to get out of the house and says it's helping.
Felix said the memorial for his uncle has been pushed back to 3 April 2027 so that the family in Canada can make it.
Book the MOT for the car. It runs out on June 21st.
Ming is vegan and can't stand mushrooms. Worth remembering for the dinner.
Vanessa and her partner Andre are hosting a small get-together on 15 November 2026. Need to RSVP and ask what to bring.
Hana lost her job at the agency. Her manager told her on a video call, which she found awful. She's applying for things but feeling pretty low. I should send her that recruiter's details.
Rosa's mum's funeral was today. It went as well as these things can. Text her tomorrow to see how she's holding up.
Had coffee with Chioma. She's thinking of retraining as a midwife and has an open day at the university on 4/22.

Giulia Rossi rang to say the trip to Lisbon in March 2027 is cancelled because her brother Nasser broke his leg skiing in Austria. He's having surgery on Monday and will be in a cast for at least six weeks. She's going to stay with him for a bit. Need to get the deposit back from the apartment people.
Laila wants to meet for a walk on Saturday morning. I said yes, Hampstead Heath at ten.

Rhys's brother died very suddenly in September. Rhys is back at work but clearly struggling. He's not sleeping and has stopped going to five-a-side. He mentioned the inquest is on January 18 and that his mum is dreading it. I must make time to take him out for a pint before then, and maybe ring him on the 18th itself.
Pay the council tax, cancel the gym membership and order more printer ink.
Aurelio is sending me the photos from the wake. He has a lovely old one of his grandad in uniform.
Catalina's dog Biscuit went missing on Tuesday and was found two streets away the next morning. She's relieved but still shaken.
Tamar asked if I could post her the book I borrowed. Her new address is in my messages.

Joanna's leaving do is on May 30 at the Crown. She's going freelance after twelve years at the firm and seems genuinely thrilled about it. Her first client is a charity she used to volunteer for. She'd love a decent pair of headphones for the train, apparently, so a few of us might chip in.
Note to self: the boiler service is on 7 November 2026 between eight and twelve. Need to work from home that day.
FaceTime with Kiri on Sunday at seven, her time. She's having a hard week after the breakup and just wants company.

Leon told me his company is closing the Manchester office at the end of March 2027 and he'll probably be made redundant. He hasn't decided whether to take the package or move to London. Honestly he seems more excited than worried. He's always wanted to try running his own bike repair business, and he's already looking at a unit near the canal.
Dr Khan said Mum's results won't be back until June 10th. Remind me to call the surgery on the 11th if we've heard nothing.
Bumped into Duc and his wife at the station. Their daughter starts university in Glasgow in September, and they're driving her up on 9/14.
Drop off the bags at the charity shop and get stamps.
Blessing said thank you for the card. The service for her grandmother was beautiful, and her aunt's staying with them until the new year.
Yusuf's brother Tiago got married in Porto last weekend. Yusuf said the speeches went on for an hour.
Don't forget to ring Uncle Gareth on 30 October 2026. It's a year since Auntie Pam passed and he'll be on his own.
Ryan and Heather are both coming to the quiz on Thursday. Book a table for four.
Rebecca's divorce was finalised on 6/2. She says she feels lighter than she has in years. Her sister Caitlin is taking her to Rome for a long weekend in July to celebrate.
Shreya mentioned she collects vintage Penguin paperbacks. The orange ones especially. Good gift idea for later in the year.
I'm taking the train to Bristol on 3 December 2026 for the conference. Hotel's booked for two nights.
Kaito texted after the meeting. They kept him on but cut his hours to four days. He's relieved but a bit worried about money.
Remind me to send Santi the link to that flat in Valencia.

Long call with Ming tonight. Her father died in Kunming on October 3rd and she couldn't get a flight in time. She's going over for the hundred-day ceremony in January 2027, and her partner Felix is going with her. She said what helps most is people saying his name rather than avoiding it. Need to check in with her before she flies and maybe send something small for the altar.

Vanessa is a primary school teacher in Croydon. She has two boys, eight and eleven, who are both obsessed with chess. She runs the after-school chess club on Wednesdays and is trying to get the older one into a junior tournament in the spring. She hates coriander, for what it's worth.
Hana's interview at the design studio is on November 4th. She's nervous because it's her first one in five years. Text her good luck the night before.
Need to sort out the spare room before the end of the month. Sell the old desk on Marketplace.
Rosa and her sister Laila are clearing out their mum's house on the weekend of 14 November 2026. I offered to help on the Sunday.
Chioma got onto the midwifery course. Starts September 2027. Send her a congratulations card.
Nothing much from the call with Nasser. Mostly football.
Grandma's ninetieth is on 21 February 2027. Ask Rhys if he's still up for doing the cake.

Aurelio's partner Catalina has just been made redundant from the hospital trust. Her last day is 12/19, right before Christmas. Aurelio says she's putting a brave face on it but he's worried. They had planned to go to Mexico in the spring, but that's on hold now. I should invite them both over for dinner sometime in December.
Tamar's twins turn three on April 8. She hinted that they'd love a play kitchen.
Pick up the prescription on Monday and return the library books on Tuesday.
Gareth called off the stag do. He said with everything going on with his dad's health it didn't feel right.
Spoke to Yaw after the funeral. His cousin Andre gave a lovely eulogy. Yaw is going back to work on 10 November 2026 but says he might need a few more days.
